CALIBRATED BINARY CONTROL EXPOSES A THERMODYNAMIC QUOTIENT
Solo construction, 31 October 2026. Priority and physical availability open.

1. THE DIFFERENT OPENING AND WHY IT WAS SELECTED

The passive coherent-generator programme minimizes over explanations of
observations. Even every passive timed law need not determine how a system
responds to an energy control. We attacked that difference by constructing
two strictly positive reciprocal eight-state generators with exactly equal
passive timed laws and opposite work signs under the SAME finite closed
protocol. Their fuel consumption is charged; this is not a new free engine.
The first smooth-response-to-staircase shortcut failed and is preserved in
opening_receipt.json. Retuning the actual finite protocol and enclosing its
periodic state gives the certified construction in work_receipt.json.
WORK_CONSTRUCTION.txt supplies its passive-equivalence, rounding, periodic
closure, fuel and finite warmup argument.

This suggested a more consequential question: can a calibrated observable
energy control make the physical hidden coordinates identifiable, or force
a thermodynamic quotient even when more hidden states remain? The result
below solves an uncapped FINITE-hidden-generator population minimum on a
specified controlled-law class. This consequence justified pursuing the
opening instead of automatically adding another passive hierarchy layer.

It pays for stronger information. Passive lower kinetic bounds do not
supply an upper cap, and the intervention contract below is not silently
available from earlier records. The passive finite-path machinery remains
valuable when such control is unavailable. All earlier artifacts remain.

THE ORGANISING MECHANISM IS SELECTIVE KINETIC CONTROL
31 October 2026. Extension of PROOF.txt; no new physical interface acquired.

The energy-field example led to a broader causal statement. The decisive
operation is uniform modulation of transitions across an observed label
cut, leaving transitions WITHIN each label unchanged. An energy field with
symmetric barrier splitting is one implementation. A symmetric kinetic
gate is another; it need not shift the state energy at all.

At the second setting suppose every off-diagonal label-crossing rate out
of a plus state is multiplied by m_+>0 and out of a minus state by m_->0.
Same-label off-diagonal rates are unchanged. Diagonals compensate. Both
multipliers must differ from1 for the formula below. Their numerical
values need NOT be supplied to the population inference.

From the two controlled observable operators, recover common Q_0,Q_1,D_+,
D_- as in(A3). The cross blocks obey

 D_+Q_1D_-=m_+ D_+Q_0D_-,
 D_-Q_1D_+=m_- D_-Q_0D_+.

Each base block is nonzero for a communicating binary process. Their
scalar proportionality factors are uniquely determined in ANY common
observable basis. Hence m_+,m_- are identified by the controlled
population law, including when the internal realization is nonminimal.
This does not qualify the physical uniformity of an unknown actuator by
fitting alone; it identifies strength WITHIN the stated actuator class.

Define

 R_m=D_+Q_0D_+ +D_-Q_0D_-
                  +m_+D_+Q_0D_- +m_-D_-Q_0D_+,
 F_m=(1-m_+)D_+ +(1-m_-)D_-.

Then C=F_m^(-1)(Q_1-R_m) is the same physical diagonal CROSS-LABEL
hazard operator as before. Every proof step for physical identification,
the observable joint-simple thermodynamic quotient and the all-finite-
hidden-generator minimum(A5) carries through with these substitutions.
The numerical gate factors are the same in every compatible model,
since their nonzero observable cross blocks force the same scalars.

Thus a symmetric kinetic gate m_+=m_-=3/2 can expose physical hidden
coordinates and the least compatible zero-field entropy rate, without
energy-bias calibration or a supplied upper escape-rate cap. It does
not measure hidden excess heating or the gate controller's work. A
conventional spectral controlled-HMM realization plus this algebra has
the same information and is the appropriate incumbent.
